findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_answers, get_answer, get_company_facts · Private data: get_services · Public sink: get_company_facts, compute_noi, compute_cap_rate, compute_cash_on_cash, compute_dscr, compute_mortgage_payment, compute_amortization, compute_break_even_occupancy, compute_max_offer_at_cap_rate, compute_flip_profit, compare_rental_vs_flip, compute_irr, compute_1031_deadlines, compute_rent_raise_turnover.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_answers, get_answer, get_company_facts · Private data: get_services · Public sink: get_company_facts, compute_noi, compute_cap_rate, compute_cash_on_cash, compute_dscr, compute_mortgage_payment, compute_amortization, compute_break_even_occupancy, compute_max_offer_at_cap_rate, compute_flip_profit, compare_rental_vs_flip, compute_irr, compute_1031_deadlines, compute_rent_raise_turnover

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
